notes: Read SKILL.md and references/verification.md in full. Guide to TileDB-VCF 0.40.3 for genomic variant storage: Conda install, bcftools compression/indexing, dataset creation and incremental ingestion, coordinate-correct region/sample queries, export, cohort statistics/QC, object storage and TileDB Cloud distributed read/ingest.

Medium because SKILL.md:40-46 tells the agent to create a Conda environment from the official tiledb and conda-forge channels with pinned versions, SKILL.md:226 to install tiledb-cloud==0.14.4, and the CLI/Python examples write local datasets and exports (cohort/, exported/, variants.tsv). TileDB Cloud use needs a TILEDB_REST_TOKEN supplied via the environment; the skill explicitly says not to embed tokens in code or print configuration (SKILL.md:228-229) and labels the cloud ingest as an illustrative mutating job for authorized tasks only (SKILL.md:255). Acceptable: pinned official packages, user-directed genomics work, and no secret exposure.

references/verification.md:24 mentions repository-level tests in tests/tiledbvcf/ outside the skill; they are provenance notes, not needed to use the skill. Cloud examples were not executed end-to-end upstream (SKILL.md:223-224).
